title: The Origins of Dominaria's Temporal Rifts
summary: Separate catastrophes at Tolaria, Shiv, Zhalfir, Urborg, Skyshroud, and Otaria weaken a single world.
narrative: The Sylex Blast, Urza's Tolarian experiments, Teferi's phasing, the Rathi Overlay, and Karona's emergence left different kinds of damage in Dominaria's history.
The wounds accumulated and accelerated the loss of mana, so a local solution could have consequences for other regions.
